title: Beef, swede and lentil pot with clementine

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Beef, vegetables, tinned tomatoes, lentils and stock are all plain home staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Stewing beef, swede, clementines and green lentils are everyday supermarket items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and a wooden spoon, and browning and simmering are beginner techniques.

works.reason: 500g beef with 150g lentils, root veg and 900ml stock, simmered for 1 hour 40 minutes, makes a sensible tender stew for four.

honest_times.reason: The pace asked for is quick, but this is a 100-minute braise plus 20 minutes' prep, about two hours in all, which is not a quick lunch.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears, and the step's 'paprika' clearly means the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: The hero swede is just one small swede added late to a dish titled and built around the beef, so swede is not the point of the page.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: A beef, lentil and root vegetable stew is a filling, balanced family meal.
